---
title: "Pre-processing workflow"
description: "Use source-aware transformation, imputation and normalization while preserving an observed pre-imputation matrix for Recommended DEP."
---

## Shared workflow

After Search/import has produced a real protein-by-sample matrix, the GUI presents:

**Correct Noise → Data Transformation → Data Imputation → Data Normalization**

Schema v4 appends every successful stage as a new run. The active matrix advances through the workflow, while prior matrix states remain recoverable.

## Source-aware defaults

ProtVis 0.9.1 can resolve **Auto (source recommended)** settings. For MaxQuant, the archived-compatible preset is:

**replicate correction → log2(intensity × 1e7) → kNN (seed 12345) → sample-median normalization + historical row shift**

For other sources, defaults are more conservative and can be changed explicitly in the module.

## 1. Correct Noise

Correct Noise performs replicate-aware correction when `_1/_2/_3` sample suffixes are available, removes all-zero proteins in that replicate workflow, and safely collapses duplicated protein IDs before reshaping. If recognizable replicate suffixes are absent, the validated matrix is retained without forcing replicate correction.

Read [Correct noise](correct_noise.qmd).

## 2. Data Transformation

The current menu includes **Auto (source recommended)**, **MaxQuant: log2(x × 1e7)**, **log2**, **None**, **log10**, plus advanced Z-score/scale/center options. The transformation method is stored with the project and later used to infer normalization input scale.

Read [Data transformation](data_transformed.qmd).

## 3. Data Imputation

The current GUI offers **kNN**, **RF**, **Mean**, **Median**, and **Minimum**. It no longer exposes Zero or MinProb/q controls. A **Random seed** is explicit (default `12345`) so stochastic/reproducibility-sensitive methods can be repeated.

Read [Data imputation](data_imputation.qmd).

## 4. Data Normalization

Normalization is no longer fixed to median subtraction. Current methods include **Median, Quantile, VSN, Cyclic Loess, RLR** and a proteiNorm-compatible family, plus a source-aware Auto preset. **Compare all methods** calculates diagnostic metrics rather than silently selecting a winner.

Read [Data normalization](data_normalization.qmd).

## Important change for differential analysis

::: {.callout-important}
### Imputation is not the default inferential input
**Recommended DEP** deliberately uses the observed **Step4 transformed matrix before imputation**, then applies its own sample-median centering and detection filter. Step5/Step6 remain important for complete-matrix visualization, QC and analyses that explicitly require imputed/normalized data, but they do not force imputed values into the default DEP model.
:::
